items.description: Alasora is one of the twelve sacred hills of Imerina, housing ancient royal tombs and remnants of early Merina monarchical settlement.
Nosy Mangabe island features rocks with historic inscriptions left by 17th-century Dutch sailors, a testament to early maritime exploration in Madagascar.
The foothills of Boby Peak, the second-highest mountain in Madagascar, offer spectacular rugged terrain and views of the Andringitra massif.
The Manongarivo Massif is a rugged mountain range in northwestern Madagascar known for its dramatic topography and secluded wilderness.
Vohimana is a unique mountainous region featuring complex topographical features, crucial for local water management and forest biodiversity.
The hills surrounding Ranomafana display steep, verdant slopes characteristic of the eastern escarpment, home to unique rainforest flora.
